slots.label: What photosynthesis needs and makes
slots.labelAf: Wat fotosintese nodig het en maak

items.q: Which two raw materials does a plant use for photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Watter twee grondstowwe gebruik ’n plant vir fotosintese?
items.explain: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water, with light energy, to make glucose and oxygen.
items.explainAf: Fotosintese gebruik koolstofdioksied en water, met lig-energie, om glukose en suurstof te maak.

items.q: Which gas is released by a plant during photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Watter gas word deur ’n plant tydens fotosintese vrygestel?
items.explain: Oxygen is a by-product of photosynthesis, released into the air through the leaves.
items.explainAf: Suurstof is ’n byproduk van fotosintese en word deur die blare in die lug vrygestel.

items.q: A leaf is kept in a dark cupboard for two days. What happens to its ability to photosynthesise?
items.qAf: ’n Blaar word twee dae lank in ’n donker kas gehou. Wat gebeur met sy vermoë om te fotosintetiseer?
options: It stops, because light is needed
optionsAf: Dit hou op, omdat lig nodig is
items.explain: Light energy is needed to drive photosynthesis, so without light the leaf cannot make glucose.
items.explainAf: Lig-energie is nodig om fotosintese aan die gang te hou, so sonder lig kan die blaar nie glukose maak nie.

items.q: Which process uses oxygen and releases carbon dioxide?
items.qAf: Watter proses gebruik suurstof en stel koolstofdioksied vry?
items.explain: Cellular respiration breaks down glucose with oxygen, releasing energy, carbon dioxide and water.
items.explainAf: Sellulêre respirasie breek glukose af met suurstof, en stel energie, koolstofdioksied en water vry.

items.q: In bright sunlight, which process is faster in a leaf?
items.qAf: In helder sonlig, watter proses is vinniger in ’n blaar?
items.explain: In bright light photosynthesis is faster than respiration, so the leaf takes in more carbon dioxide than it gives out.
items.explainAf: In helder lig is fotosintese vinniger as respirasie, so die blaar neem meer koolstofdioksied op as wat dit afgee.

items.q: Which process releases energy stored in glucose for the plant to use?
items.qAf: Watter proses stel energie vry wat in glukose geberg is?
items.explain: Respiration releases the energy stored in glucose, which the plant needs for growth and other processes.
items.explainAf: Respirasie stel die energie vry wat in glukose geberg is, en die plant het dit nodig vir groei en ander prosesse.
